_meta.description: Per-champion SR rune recommendations for RC coaching. Hand-curated from challenger SR bot lane data, patch 16.8.

Vayne.reasoning: Tempo is mandatory - Vayne's silver bolt DPS requires sustained autos. Short-range means you need the DPS ramp to justify the all-in.

situational.vs_poke_lane: Fleet Footwork for healing in rough lane matchups
situational.vs_engage_support: Conqueror for extended fights in tanky metas

Vayne.coaching_note: Don't engage until 4+ Tempo stacks. Condemn wall-stuns extend the Tempo window. Safe uptime > risky burst.

Jinx.reasoning: Standard Jinx: Tempo into Fishbones is the primary damage pattern. Gathering Storm scales into teamfight phase where Jinx dominates.

situational.ahead: Dark Harvest for reset snowball playstyle

Jinx.coaching_note: Stay back in lane - poke with rockets when safe. Tempo fights: switch to rockets after 4 stacks. Never stop moving.

Tristana.reasoning: Tempo maximizes Explosive Charge damage windows. Tristana's all-in pattern relies on stacking charge under sustained autos.

situational.lane_bully: Electrocute for burst-heavy kill lane with aggressive support
situational.safe_lane: Fleet Footwork for passive scaling playstyle

Tristana.coaching_note: W onto target, auto x4 under Tempo stacks, pop charge at 4 stacks, E out of danger. W reset on kill is the core loop.

Caitlyn.reasoning: Fleet Footwork on SR for sustained laning - headshot procs give free healing. Manaflow handles early mana demands. Range abuse lane doesn't need Tempo.

situational.stomp_lane: Lethal Tempo if heavily favored - maximize damage output
situational.vs_melee_support: Arcane Comet for poke damage vs immobile supports

Caitlyn.coaching_note: Arcane Comet on traps/Q poke. Manaflow + Gathering Storm for scaling. Triumph + Alacrity secondary for lane sustain and team fight contribution.

Nilah.reasoning: Conqueror on SR for extended 2v2 all-ins. Nilah's kit enables long trades where Conqueror stacks matter. Resolve secondary for approach safety.

situational.poke_lane: Fleet Footwork if struggling to approach heavy poke
situational.ahead: Lethal Tempo for DPS maximization when winning

Nilah.coaching_note: Conqueror stacks in melee all-in. W reduces healing on enemies. Bone Plating essential vs burst when diving. Revitalize enhances W passive healing share.

Miss Fortune.reasoning: Tempo on MF for sustained DPS during Love Tap trading. Double Up bounce + Tempo autos is the core lane trade pattern.

situational.hard_engage_support: Dark Harvest with CC setup support for kill lane
situational.poke_lane: Arcane Comet for E scatter poke dominance

Miss Fortune.coaching_note: Arcane Comet procs off Double Up Q. Manaflow for mana. Gathering Storm into late-game lethality. Sudden Impact for Bullet Time burst setup.

Lucian.coaching_note: TF Spellblade + Tempo: Q procs Spellblade, then fire 2 Tempo autos. Never auto without a proc queued.

Ezreal.coaching_note: Arcane Comet procs on Q hits - landed Mystic Shot is a guaranteed comet. Manaflow stacks via Q spam. Gathering Storm provides scaling AD. Sudden Impact for lethality on E.

Jhin.coaching_note: Fleet Footwork sustain in lane - crits trigger it. Presence of Mind for mana on kills. Gathering Storm for scaling AD since Jhin gains AD from crit %.

Ashe.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo stacks fast on perma-slow targets. Triumph + Alacrity standard. Sudden Impact + Treasure Hunter for poke-to-kill windows.

Xayah.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo stacks fast on feather plant autos. Bloodline secondary for lifesteal in extended trades. Sudden Impact for Bladecaller burst.

Zeri.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo stacks on rapid Q autos. Alacrity for AS scaling. Sudden Impact procs on E wall-hop. Treasure Hunter for income.

Samira.coaching_note: Conqueror stacks via style combo. Triumph heals on R kills. Bone Plating + Revitalize for dive survivability in extended all-ins.

Aphelios.coaching_note: Crescendum turret fires at Tempo AS. Weapon rotation synergy with Tempo uptime.

Kalista.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo syncs with Kalista's hop-and-auto rhythm. Presence of Mind for mana. Alacrity + CdG for spear stacking efficiency.

Draven.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo into Coup de Grace - axes deal bonus AD so getting 3 autos per trade is critical. Sudden Impact + Treasure Hunter for kill snowball.

Sivir.coaching_note: Lethal Tempo stacks on Ricochet bounces. Manaflow for mana management. Gathering Storm scales with her late-game crit build.

Varus.coaching_note: Arcane Comet procs on Q poke. Manaflow for Q spam. Sudden Impact + Treasure Hunter for blight detonation kill windows.

Kog'Maw.coaching_note: W % max HP fires on every Tempo auto. 5-auto Tempo window = 5x Void Ooze procs.

Twitch.coaching_note: Deadly Venom stacks with Tempo AS. 6-stack detonation + Tempo active = execute window.

Senna.coaching_note: Long range + Fleet sustain. Umbral Glaive denies health packs. Dawning Shadow (R) globally.

Corki.coaching_note: Hybrid damage: Q magic + autos. Fleet sustain in poke lanes. Package W/E path rotations.

Quinn.coaching_note: Valor tag proc + Tempo auto for bonus damage. Behind Enemy Lines (R) engage with Tempo active.
